subject: Hot queue resolved: follow-up and next steps for Heliotrope
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliotrope.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High tail latency — dedicated pool hot queue

Hi Markus / Ben,

We're seeing a sustained spike in tail latency and a backlog on our Dedicated pool (region: us-west-2) starting ~08:45 PDT. Several inference jobs are timing out; traffic is steady but individual tail latencies are spiking >2.5x. Error rates for our streaming endpoints are up.

Can you confirm whether this is a platform-level issue or something isolated to our reserved nodes? We're on a committed Dedicated plan (DEAL-11234) and this is impacting a small production cohort.

I've attached a short CSV with request-level latency samples and a few request_ids for debugging.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
SRE, Heliotrope AI
[Attachment: rl_metrics.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliotrope.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency — dedicated pool hot queue

Hi Samantha — thanks for the fast heads-up and for the samples. We're investigating now. Quick notes: 

- We've identified a short-lived eviction surge affecting a subset of reserved nodes in us-west-2 that can amplify queueing for long-running generation requests.
- Our on-call has opened INC-2028 and is performing a rolling mitigation (eviction backoff + temporary capacity surge) to drain the hot queue.

Immediate actions I'm putting in place:
1) Force an incremental warm-up to the affected node set to rebuild KV caches.
2) Route new low-latency traffic to a healthy fallback pool for the next 30 minutes.
3) Capture a full heap/profile and the kernel scheduling trace for the affected nodes and share artifacts.

I'll follow up with a brief timeline and a proposed credit offer once we have a post-incident summary. Apologies for the impact — we'll get you stable and provide concrete remediation steps.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliotrope.ai>
Sent: Fri, Sep 21, 2028 at 09:12 AM
Subject: High tail latency — dedicated pool hot queue

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency — dedicated pool hot queue

Markus — quick update from infra: we saw an autoscale cooldown misfire combined with a node preemption wave (cloud provider thin-preempt). The scheduler's fairshare algorithm queued up long sequences of KV-warm requests, causing head-of-line blocking for the rest.

I've pushed a targeted hot-queue drain (priority requeue) and temporarily relaxed the autoscale cooldown for the affected pool. Early signs show queue depth dropping and p99 latency trending down. Will keep monitoring.

-Ben
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliotrope.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency — dedicated pool hot queue

Thanks — we see the errors dropping and overall throughput returning to baseline (our monitoring shows p99 back within SLA at ~10:55 PDT). Appreciate the quick action.

A couple of asks while we wait for the postmortem:
- Can you provide the exact window (start/stop) and a short root-cause summary we can share with our internal incident review?
- We'll likely request a small service credit for the impacted minutes — what's Redwood's approach for Dedicated plans?

Also looping procurement (procurement@heliotrope.ai) in case they want to start the billing conversation.

— Samantha

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliotrope.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, procurement@heliotrope.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Incident summary and next steps — Heliotrope Dedicated pool (INC-2028)

Samantha / team,

Attached is a brief incident_summary.pdf with:
- timeline of the event (detected 08:45 PDT; mitigations applied 09:05–09:20 PDT; p99 recovered by 10:55 PDT)
- root cause: eviction wave + autoscaler cooldown misconfiguration causing KV-warm head-of-line blocking
- immediate mitigations: priority requeue, autoscale cooldown override, KV-cache warm-up rollout
- long-term actions: autoscaler safety net, pre-warm policy for long-seq workloads, improved eviction detection alerts

We own the full postmortem and will upload a detailed RCA to INC-2028 in Jira (link below). Separately, I've proposed a one-off service credit equal to the committed-minute prorate for the impacted 90-minute window. Ben / Naomi — please coordinate the credit and send a billing memo to procurement.

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical review call Monday to walk through the RCA and the mitigation plan. Proposed times: Mon 09:00 PDT or Mon 16:00 PDT — which works for you?

Markus
[Attachment: incident_summary.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2028

From: procurement@heliotrope.ai
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@heliotrope.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Sep 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incident summary and next steps — Heliotrope Dedicated pool (INC-2028)

Thanks Markus — we appreciate the clarity and the proposed credit. Mon 09:00 PDT works for a call. Two quick asks for the billing memo:
- please include the exact credit calculation (minutes, rate, prorate assumptions)
- any confirmation that our committed capacity SLA remains intact after your mitigations

We'll join the call with Finance and SRE.

Procurement
Heliotrope AI
